doc.title: Ralph Sutton interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 22, 1995

title: First job back in East St. Louis at Bowman's
summary: After discharge he took the train to St. Louis and played piano at Bowman's restaurant.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: I got out of the Army and let’s see, I was down in the Mojave Desert on maneuvers. I ended up in Colorado Springs at the Camp Carson. And that’s where I got my discharge. And I took the train back to St. Louis from Colorado Springs, and my first job was in East St. Louis at a place called Bowman’s. It was a restaurant, and they had gambling in Illinois then. So that was my first job, playing piano in this restaurant.
